actualchecks.details: Actual UI hook POSTs /api/v1/attempts/{id}/regrade; real repository generates attempt_ plus 32 lowercase hex characters, accepted by observer regex. Original target test triggers this POST via UI on both pages, while page.request result polls remain separately observed. Actual Reader source uses GET /api/v1/blocks/{id} and GET /api/v1/blocks/{id}/body; passive events match these browser requests

At most two pages, eight tracked requests, four pending and 32 emitted events; excess requests are not entered in the WeakMap. Terminal events mark settled and decrement pending before event-capacity drop. Listener cleanup runs after saved freeze with bounded detach callbacks; callbacks return after freeze. No asynchronous observer task or unawaited new body reader

At most 32 tracked material requests, eight material pending and 128 emitted material events. Capacity-excess requests have no material record; terminal settle/decrement occurs before event drop, preventing full output arrays from leaking material pending. Existing generic route WeakMap remains weak-keyed. Frozen check precedes new callbacks; existing listener cleanup remains in finally

New fields contain fixed event/kind/route enums, bounded synthetic ordinals, numeric status/duration and booleans; no object IDs, URLs, query, secrets, body, raw headers or raw errors. Regrade response headers remain distinct from finished 202 ACK and do not prove UI consumption, worker claim or grade completion. Material network finish does not prove metadata/body hash validation, owner validity, discard, React completion or open; final owner_current/discarded/open_called are literal NOT_OBSERVED. Review body clock is explicitly distinct from setup/helper timing; no server-clock equivalence or zero-overhead claim

Request/Response are Playwright types already referenced by original tests. New synchronous listeners use existing request/response/requestfinished/requestfailed APIs. Literal MaterialEvent union matches all four callbacks; WeakMap/WeakSet keys are Playwright objects. This is not a TypeScript parser or typecheck result
